summary: Correct, minimal fix: guards the --pdb tearDown postponement with a skip check, and consolidates the repeated `__unittest_skip__` lookups into a single `_is_skipped` helper used consistently in all three sites. Resolves the reported issue without regression or compatibility risk.

issues.description: `_is_skipped` docstring says "marked with @unittest.skip" but the helper is also applied to a class object in collect(); wording is slightly narrow. Trivial, non-blocking.
